config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.tooltip: These settings are synced with the server and need operator permissions to change (you need to be OP).
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.no_permi: You don't have permission to change this part of the config
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fog.desc: These settings control the underwater darkness effect, which simulates the lack of light in deep/abyssal underwater environments
Turns on progressive darkness as you go deeper underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssDepthStart: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect starts
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssMaxDepth.t: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect reaches its maximum darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogDarknessInte: Multiplier for how much the fog closes in as you go deeper
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableDepthVign: Turns the dark vignette around the screen edges on or off when exploring deep areas
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.vignetteIntensi: Controls the overall opacity and intensity of the dark vignette on screen
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lightDimmingStr: Determines how much ambient light and fog darken as you go down into the ocean
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssColorReten: Sets what percentage of the biome's natural water color stays visible in the abyssal darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.marine_sn: Controls how marine snow particles look and behave underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.maxMarinSnowPar: Sets the max number of marine snow particles visible underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowDensi: Multiplier for how many marine snow particles spawn per tick
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowVisib: Radius in blocks where marine snow particles can appear
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSwayA: Adjusts how much marine snow particles sway side to side
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSpawn: Sets how high above the player marine snow starts spawning
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogRepellerInfl: How much a nearby fog repeller reduces the abyssal darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogRepellerNear: Determines how strongly a fog repeller pushes back the abyssal fog at close range
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogRepellerFarP: Determines how strongly a fog repeller pushes back the maximum opacity of the abyssal fog at long range
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.conduit.d: Settings for the particles that mark the edge of a conduit's range
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.conduitBoundary: Turns the visual particles marking a conduit's domain boundary on or off
Distance (in blocks) at which the warning ring shows up as you approach the edge of a conduit's domain
Sets the radius of the particle ring that marks the conduit's boundary
The number of particles used to draw the conduit's boundary ring. A higher value gives a denser ring
The interval (in ticks) between each spawn of the conduit boundary warning particles
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.surface_o:
Visually darkens the water surface.

Warning: this option can hit your FPS when you're in deep oceans.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableSurfaceOc: Turns the darkening of deep water seen from above on or off
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.surfaceOccluder: Base opacity of the layers closest to the surface. A higher value makes shallow water darker
Maximum opacity reached by the deepest layers. Controls how opaque deep water can get
Number of stacked layers used to build the darkness gradient. More layers = smoother transition but costs more FPS & CPU usage
How fast details fade in as you enter a new area. A low value gives a slow fade
Width in blocks of the level-of-detail bands. A larger value cuts down on calculations by merging distant bands, at the cost of precision

Position of the max darkness depth (the last vertical band) between Abyss Start (0%) and Max Depth (100%). 

At 50%, max darkness is reached halfway between the two.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.entity.de: These settings configure the behavior of Abyssal Bloom's entities
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.strictBarnacleS: Stops other mods' Barnacles from spawning if this is on
List of settings for the mod's various mobs
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.strictBarnacleS: Stops other mods' entities with "barnacle" in the name from spawning
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacle.desc: Barnacles are hostile aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They're known for their huge mouth that can open wide enough to swallow players and other entities. They also hate Guardians and will attack aggressively if they spot one nearby.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleSpawnMa: Max Y level at which Barnacles can spawn naturally
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleDetecti: Max distance in blocks at which a Barnacle can detect prey
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleMovemen: Max speed of the accelerations used when chasing prey
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleObstacl: Max speed when the Barnacle is pathing around obstacles
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleFleeSpe: Max speed of a badly hurt Barnacle while fleeing
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleRegenCo: Number of ticks out of combat (since the last hit taken) between Barnacle heals
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleDirectC:
Distance at which the Barnacle can drop its pathing if the direct route through water is clear 

(basically just going in a straight line instead of a more expensive complex path)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleCapture: Max distance at which the Barnacle can grab prey
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleHoldDis: Distance at which captured prey is held in front of the Barnacle
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brine.desc:
Brines are dense clumps of bubbles that wander the ocean floor. They attack either by shooting bubbles straight at their target, or by creating a vortex above themselves while bombarding the area with bubbles. 

Fragile: any exposure to air is fatal to them
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineNaturalSpa: Allows Brines to spawn naturally in deep ocean biomes
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineDetectionR: Max distance in blocks at which a Brine can detect players
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineFollowSpee: Horizontal speed used to follow a player
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackSpee: Horizontal speed used to get into position before attacking
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackEnte: Horizontal distance at which a Brine switches from chasing to attacking (when it creates the vortex)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackExit: Horizontal distance beyond which a Brine drops its attack behavior (when it stops the vortex)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineColumnAtta: Number of ticks between projectiles in the bubble column attack
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineDirectAtta: Number of ticks between direct bubble projectiles
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.red_slobberer.d: Red Slobberers are peaceful giant sea slugs. Their groups graze on Blood Grass and gradually help a living reef take shape (coral and small calcareous patches). They also help out nearby fish schools by acting as a refuge for them
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererSpa: Allows Red Slobberers to spawn naturally
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererRee: Shows anchors, deposits, and active refuges with particles, then writes a diagnostic to the server logs
Number of ticks a group needs to stay in an area before its local reef matures (allowing coral, calcareous patches, etc. to appear)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMax: Red Slobberer Reef Max Fish Population
Max number of fish a mature Red Slobberer reef can support
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDep:
Minimum number of ticks between two limestone deposit checks for the same reef 

(the minimum time between each attempt to place a limestone deposit)

Maximum number of ticks between two calcareous deposit checks for the same reef. 

(the maximum time between each attempt to place a limestone deposit)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMax: Caps the number of calcareous deposits around a single reef
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMin:
Minimum collective stability needed for the reef to mature and produce limestone deposits 

(Stability reflects whether a reef is "active" or not, things like fish panicking, Red Slobberers moving around a lot, etc.)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDep: Base chance that an existing deposit advances a stage on a given check
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererNew: Base chance that a mature reef tries to place a new deposit on a given check
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDec: Minimum number of ticks between two decoration checks for the same reef
Maximum number of ticks between two decoration checks for the same reef
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMax: Caps the number of corals and sea pickles placed around a single reef
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDec: Base chance that a mature reef attempts to place a decoration during a check, scaled by its collective activity and stability
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererFis: Max distance at which a fish from the same reef can pick a Red Slobberer as shelter
Max number of fish a Red Slobberer can shelter
Minimum time a fish stays hidden after entering
Maximum time a fish can stay hidden, even if the danger is still around
Time without a nearby threat before hidden fish can come back out
How long a hurt Red Slobberer can't take in any more fish (or babies)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererRee: Radius around the anchor (reef center) where Red Slobberers wander and naturally look for food
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.mackerel.desc: Mackerel are fish that swim in schools in temperate and cold oceans
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.mackerelMaxSpaw:
Mackerel won't spawn in oceans whose climate temperature parameter is at or above this value 

(0.55 is the vanilla warm ocean threshold)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fish_scho: Controls a fish school's collective movement using a mathematical model
Neighbor detection, field of view, and the friendly entities manager
When collective movement kicks in, and when it hands control back to the vanilla AI
The base boids weights that determine how a school holds together and moves
How fish detect, spread, and react to nearby threats
Speed/rotation limits and the slow shared depth current
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolEnabl: Turns on collective school movement. If disabled, all fish keep their vanilla AI
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDebug: Shows the collective state, neighbor links, and movement vectors with particles, then writes a summary to the server logs every five seconds
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolFrien:
Add or remove entities exempt from fish schools' threat detection, on top of the existing entity tag 

This decides which entities won't "scare" the fish
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.entityListManag: Adds or removes this entity from the list. Entities already covered by a tag don't need to be added
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolNeigh:
Max number of nearest compatible fish each fish uses for its local movement 

(the max number of neighbors a fish bases its movement on)
Max distance used to find potential neighbors before picking the closest ones.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolAggre: Max range of a weak, temporary pull that lets nearby schools meet up and merge
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCross: Relative influence of compatible fish from another species. A low value favors same-species schooling without ruling out mixed schools
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolActiv: Number of nearby compatible fish needed before collective movement kicks in
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDeact: The vanilla AI takes back control once the number of nearby fish stays at or below this value
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolActiv: Number of ticks the activation density has to stay stable before collective movement kicks in
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDeact: Number of ticks the density has to stay too low before fully reverting to vanilla movement
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolNeigh: Number of ticks between nearby fish and blocker lookups
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolThrea: Number of ticks between direct threat lookups. Signals still propagate through the school every tick
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolLongR: Number of ticks between distant school aggregation and environmental influence lookups
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolSepar: How strongly fish avoid obstacles and anticipate collisions with their neighbors
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolAlign: How strongly fish gradually align with their neighbors' actual movement
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCohes: How strongly fish are pulled toward the local center formed by just their closest neighbors
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolObsta: How strongly fish gradually avoid blocks, tight passages, and large nearby entities
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolThrea: Distance in blocks at which a fish can directly detect a threat
Fraction of the threat signal passed from a fish to its closest neighbors.
Intensity lost per tick once the danger is no longer directly detected (the threat signal gradually fading out)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolMaxim: Max speed set for normal collective movement.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolPanic: Max speed a fish approaches when it's carrying a strong local threat signal
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolMaxim: Max horizontal heading change in degrees per tick. Vertical turns use smooth acceleration
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolVerti: Max vertical speed of the slow shared current that gradually pushes fish schools up and down. At zero, they stay at the same depth
How strongly vertical guidance applies outside of avoidance maneuvers. A low value keeps movement mostly horizontal
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolNeigh:
Angle of the forward cone used to filter alignment and cohesion with neighbors.

Separation ignores this setting
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolAggre: Fraction of the cohesion strength applied to the long-range pull that lets nearby schools merge
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCohes: How strongly speed is adjusted to keep an even distance between fish, independent of the school's cohesion
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolSepar: Distance in blocks at which fish start spreading out to avoid collisions
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolMaxim: Max cap applied to the separation force between fish
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCohes: Distance in blocks beyond which fish actively try to get back to the school's center
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolHerdC: How strongly panicking fish additionally tighten toward the center of their neighbor group, on top of fleeing
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.ocean_ter: Manages the territorial competition between mods for generating ocean biomes
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryE: Size of the ocean territories generated by mods. The higher the value, the bigger the territories. The same mod will then generate more biomes in the same area, which makes other mods' territories rarer and harder to find
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryD: Default weight given to an unknown mod during territorial competition
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryO: Abyssal Bloom's specific weight in the competition relative to other mods
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryI:
If this option is off, vanilla ocean biomes act as a fallback instead of competing with mod biomes for territory 

(the more ocean biomes get added, the fewer classic vanilla oceans are left)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.worldgen.toolti: Controls the shape of the ocean terrain
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.ocean_zon: Continentalness thresholds for the three ocean zones
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowDeepBoun: Continentalness threshold between shallow ocean and deep ocean. Vanilla uses -0.455
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepAbyssalBoun: Continentalness threshold between the deep zone and the abyssal zone
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.terrain_z:
Average Y height for each ocean zone 

(actual terrain can be higher or lower due to terrain variation and biomes)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowFloorY.d: Target central Y height for the shallow water floor
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepFloorTarget: Target central Y height for the deep water floor
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.targetFloorY.de: Target central Y height for the abyssal water floor
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowClearanc:
Minimum water depth (in blocks) above the shallow floor 

(keeps the floor from poking above the surface)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.topo.desc: Noise amplitudes that shape the abyssal floor. Each layer adds structure at a different scale, from large-scale stretches down to the finest surface detail
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warpAmp.desc: Warps the terrain during generation. Higher values create more winding, natural-looking landscapes
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warp2Amp.desc: A second, finer warp layered on top of the first, adding extra curves
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoLargeAmp.de: Controls the size of the abyss's biggest features, like huge mountains and wide basins
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoAmp.desc: Mid-level terrain layered on top of the large-scale amplitude, responsible for hills and valleys inside each basin
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoMidAmp.desc: Fine-grained variation that adds diversity to the terrain surface, cutting down on the smooth look in the flattest sections
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.wallAmp.desc: Controls the height of ridge formations. It never digs into the floor, it only raises it
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.detailAmp.desc: Adds small variations to the terrain to keep abyssal plains from looking too flat, and throws in a bit more chaos
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.microAmp.desc: Adds the smallest terrain details, like the light ripples in sediment on the ocean floor
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.weirdnessAmp.de:
How much Minecraft's climate weirdness parameter warps the abyssal floor. 

(higher values tie depth more strongly to biome variation)
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.faults.de: Tectonic fractures that vertically shift chunks of the seafloor, creating cliffs or sudden steps
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.faultFrequencyP: Percentage of the abyssal floor covered by faults. Higher values spread faults across more of the floor
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.faultBlend.desc:
How gradual the transition is at the edge of a fault 

(a low value produces steeper, sharper cliffs)
Max height difference (in blocks) between the two sides of a fault
Deep cuts in the abyssal floor, trenches are the lowest points in the ocean
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.trenchFrequency: Percentage of the abyssal floor that can carve into trenches
Max depth a trench can reach below the surrounding abyssal floor
Stair-like ledges cut into abyssal slopes. They only show up in certain areas and give cliffs a layered, geological look
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceFrequenc: Percentage of abyssal slopes that can form terraces
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceStep.des: Vertical height in blocks of each terrace step

death.attack.squ_abyssal_bloom.bubble_bu: %1$s was burst by a %2$s whilst fighting %3$s

%1$s was crushed by the underwater pressure whilst fighting %2$s
item.squ_abyssal_bloom.barbed_nautilus_s: You don't suppose to see this item, do you ?
